lines.say: If you find this note taped to your laptop at three oh seven AM, follow the rules.
lines.cap: If you find this note taped to your laptop at 3:07 AM... follow the rules.

lines.say: Rule one. At the Starlite gas station, never turn on pump four.
lines.cap: Rule 1. At the Starlite gas station, never turn on pump 4.

lines.say: Rule two. At the Pinewood Motel, check their eyes before you hand over a key. Not every guest is human.
lines.cap: Rule 2. At the Pinewood Motel, check their eyes before you hand over a key. Not every guest is human.

lines.say: Rule three. If something at the cabin door uses a voice you know, don't answer it.
lines.cap: Rule 3. If something at the cabin door uses a voice you know... don't answer it.

lines.say: Rule four. In Saint Verity Hospital, never stop looking at the dolls.
lines.cap: Rule 4. In Saint Verity Hospital, never stop looking at the dolls.

lines.say: Rule five. If the office starts repeating, find three fuses, and keep going down.
lines.cap: Rule 5. If the office starts repeating, find 3 fuses, and keep going down.

lines.say: Rule six. If the elevator stops at a floor the building doesn't have, don't get out.
lines.cap: Rule 6. If the elevator stops at a floor the building doesn't have... don't get out.

lines.say: Rule seven. Under the sea, don't ping too much. Something down there hears every one.
lines.cap: Rule 7. Under the sea, don't ping too much. Something down there hears every one.

lines.say: Rule eight. In the haunted house, when the lights flicker, it's hunting.
lines.cap: Rule 8. In the haunted house, when the lights flicker... it's hunting.

lines.say: And the last rule, scribbled at the very bottom.
lines.cap: And the last rule... scribbled at the very bottom.

lines.say: It was your friends. With snacks. And a room code.
lines.cap: It was your friends. With snacks. And a room code.

lines.say: Still Here, The Hollow and Dead Air let up to four of you play together.
lines.cap: Still Here, The Hollow and Dead Air let up to 4 of you play together.
